newsitem.title: MACAU: Bomb blast outside Macau money-changer, none hurt.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast outside Macau money-changer, none hurt.

text.p: A home-made bomb exploded outside a bureau de change in Macau early on Saturday in the 14th bomb attack to hit the Portuguese-administered territory this year, police said.
No one was hurt in the explosion in Macau's outer harbour area shortly after midnight, but the blast destroyed dozens of windows in nearby buildings and windscreens of parked cars.

A police spokesman said the motive for the bomb atack was not immediately known, but official sources have said they believe most of the attacks this year are the result of gangland conflicts over disputed property deals and gambling businesses.

The 14 bombs this year have exploded on casino premises and outside jewellery shops, private homes and restaurants, including McDonald's fast food outlets. At least seven people have sustained light injuries as a result of the blasts.
